top_signals.title: Visa, Mesh partner to enable crypto spending at 175M merchant locations
top_signals.summary: Mesh will connect crypto and stablecoin wallets to Visa’s global payment network, allowing users to spend digital assets without a separate card.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Recent Changes in U.S. At-Sea Interdiction of Illicit Narcotics
top_signals.summary: Sometime back in the fall of 2025, I was contacted by a prominent national television, radio, and print news reporter with a surprising (but understandable under the circumstances) request for background information to inform her reporting.

top_signals.title: Dredging is Building the Next Generation of Northeast and Mid-Atlantic Ports
top_signals.summary: The United States’ Mid-Atlantic and Northeast regions have good dredging stories to tell. Major channel projects have been completed. Ports are investing in new capacity. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE) and its partners are advancing more work across the region.
